description: Same synthesis behavior as harlots-eight, plus one injected fault: the THIRD extract-chunk request this JVM sees for this set gets an emulated HTTP 500 ({"error":{"message":"emulated failure"}}). The chunk loop sees a fast null, retries once, and the retry succeeds -- exercising the retry path without a real outage. Fault occurrence counters live in the Tomcat JVM: reset them with GET /rest/chat/emulator/stats?reset=true before a run that depends on this firing. Modes: http500 | unreachable (ConnectException -> Chat.isLastCallUnreachable()) | empty (content '[]').
